proofs.text: Run `--gate recorded --dry-run` on a git project and verify the summary names `.purlin/config.json` while `.purlin` was not created and no workflow was written; run the same in a directory that is not a git repository and verify exit 0, the framework question asked, the summary printed, the last line starting with the arrow and the directory still empty

rule_text: `--dry-run` prints the plan and writes nothing, inside a git repository or outside one

tests.body:
def test_dry_run_writes_nothing_and_prints_the_plan(self):
        made = Project('pytest')
        try:
            output = made.run('--gate', 'recorded', '--dry-run')
            assert '.purlin/config.json' in summary_paths(output)
            assert not made.has('.purlin')
            assert not made.has('conftest.py') or read(
                made.path('conftest.py')) == ''
            assert not made.has('.github/workflows/purlin.yml')
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_dry_run_outside_a_repository_still_prints_the_plan
